q: At DMA Design, who proposed giving the first GTA one radio station per genre so a musician's demos could all survive?
why: Colin Anderson of DMA Design's sound department pitched genre stations so Craig Conner's demos in many genres would not have to be cut.

q: Who voiced K-DST's Tommy "The Nightmare" Smith in GTA San Andreas?
why: Axl Rose played Tommy Smith on K-DST. George Clinton was Bounce FM's The Funktipus and Chuck D was Playback FM's Forth Right MC.

q: Which fashion designer hosted K109 The Studio, GTA IV's disco station?
why: Karl Lagerfeld hosted K109 The Studio; Iggy Pop had Liberty Rock Radio.

q: How many licensed songs did GTA V have at launch in September 2013, per soundtrack supervisor Ivan Pavlovich?
why: Pavlovich gave 240 songs across 15 music stations. The 165 is the number of tracks the 2014 edition for newer consoles added.

q: Who voiced Richard Burns, the WCTR News reporter in GTA San Andreas?
why: Wil Wheaton confirmed the role on his own blog in 2004. Lazlow offered it after interviewing him for Technofile.

q: Which comedian voices Dr. Ray De Angelo Harris on GTA V's Chakra Attack?
why: J.B. Smoove voiced the WCTR mindfulness host and came to Rockstar through DJ Pooh, he told PC Gamer in 2018.

q: How did some real fans end up as callers on WKTT's Richard Bastion Show in GTA IV?
options: They left messages on a phone line from the WKTTRadio.com teaser site
They won a Rockstar Newswire contest
They were recorded at a Comic-Con panel
They called into Lazlow's Technofile show
why: In July 2007 Rockstar's WKTTRadio.com teaser listed a New York number for fans' complaints, and some of the calls made it onto the show.

q: Who does Guinness list as the first real celebrity to appear as themselves in a GTA game?
why: Phil Collins appears in Vice City Stories (2006), where Victor Vance protects him so his concert can go ahead. He is not a radio host.

q: Which Los Angeles band composed and recorded the Max Payne 3 soundtrack?
why: HEALTH scored Max Payne 3 in 2012 and later appeared on GTA Online's 2023 original score album.

q: Bill Elm and Woody Jackson recorded the Red Dead Redemption score at 130 BPM in one key. Which?
why: All 14-plus hours were recorded at 130 BPM in A minor, with Morricone's Dollars Trilogy as the touchstone.

q: Which of these DJs was NOT one of the four After Hours nightclub residents in 2018?
why: The four residents were Solomun, Tale Of Us, Dixon and The Black Madonna. Moodymann was a resident at The Music Locker, added with Cayo Perico in 2020.

q: Six new Dr. Dre tracks premiered inside which GTA Online update?
why: The Contract (December 15, 2021) built missions around six Dre tracks, which reached streaming services in early February 2022, about seven weeks later.

q: CircoLoco, Rockstar's partner in CircoLoco Records, is the Monday party at which Ibiza club?
why: CircoLoco began at DC10 in 1999 as a free Monday-morning after-party.

q: Jamback's "Positive" on CircoLoco Records set the record for the longest run at No. 1 on Beatport. How many days?
why: Beatport reported 64 days at No. 1, passing FISHER's 62 days for "Losing It" in 2018.

q: How many songs were removed from the PC version of GTA San Andreas in November 2014?
why: A Steam update cut 17 songs so the PC version matched mobile. Rockstar said nothing; PC Gamer read it as expired licenses.

q: Which song did a GTA V Enhanced hotfix remove from Non-Stop-Pop FM around September 15, 2026?
why: The hotfix cut Moloko's "The Time Is Now" and was expected to reach consoles. Rockstar said nothing; the press blames an expired license, unconfirmed.

q: Which song plays in GTA VI's first trailer from December 2023?
options: Tom Petty, "Love Is a Long Road"
why: Trailer 1 used Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road" from Full Moon Fever. "Hot Together" scored Trailer 2 in May 2025.

q: Who hosts The Chamber 106.6, the metal station Rockstar named for GTA VI on October 8, 2026?
why: The station is hosted by DJ Kerry and DJ Tom, played by Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya.
